title: Certificate Auto-Renewal
intro: **Where challenges run.** The shared pieces are the CA (`step-ca`), `demo-app` and the `certs.dojo.test` zone. A challenge changes only the student's own vhost directory (`/srv/webroot/{user}/`) and names under `{user}.certs.dojo.test`, which is exactly what the DNS gate's per-student key already allows. No challenge reconfigures the CA, nginx or the zone's shared records. The student's hostname is `{user}.certs.dojo.test`. Triggers here: `shell:`, `verify:` (end state on `demo-app` or the CA), `ca:` (CA log), `dns:` (dns-gate lines).
challenges_intro:
At open, the service seeds one wildcard A record `*.{user}.certs.dojo.test` to `demo-app` (through the DNS gate, in the
student's own scope), so any new hostname the challenge needs already resolves. Verifiers read the student's own
vhost directory and the certificate `demo-app` serves for their own hostnames only.
